mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate sympathomimetic effects of levothyroxine, increasing risk of hypertension, tachycardia, and thyroid storm, particularly in hyperthyroid states.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and thyroid function closely; ensure levothyroxine dose is optimized and stable before initiating MAOI therapy; consider alternative antidepressant if possible.
